item.title: Hoo-ho-ho. Let's reduce spending
item.description: The recent Black Friday shopping spree started the spending trend. To participate in this, many people, unfortunately, take out loans and spend excessively on non-essential items, putting wants ahead of true needs.

item.title: Kwinika: Chiefs ready to reset for Chippa after CAF disruption
item.description: Zitha Kwinika has emphasised the need for Kaizer Chiefs to reset after CAF duties, as they visit Chippa United in Gqeberha on Wednesday, aiming to build momentum in the Betway Premiership. Photo: Backpagepix

item.title: Why a UK expat found Durban to be the ideal city for family life
item.description: For some, Durban embodies a sanctuary where life is rich with community, purpose, and the beauty of the coast.

item.title: From vision loss to recovery: Samson's journey with a pituitary adenoma
item.description: New medical techniques mean brain tumours no longer require cutting through the skull for treatment. And recovery times are much shorter too.

item.title: Mokwena, Dladla and De Sa lead Durban City’s coaching search
item.description: Durban City part ways with Gavin Hunt and shortlist Rulani Mokwena, pictured, Simo Dladla and Roger de Sa as potential successors ahead of the AFCON break, with Pitso Dladla taking interim charge. Photo: Backpagepix

item.title: Kolisi rallies Sharks after Connacht mauling ahead of busy December
item.description: Springbok captain Siya Kolisi as called for renewed energy and leadership at the Sharks after a heavy Connacht defeat, with a busy December ahead in the Champions Cup and URC. Photo: AFP

item.title: Lindi Ngonelo steps into her power with debut jazz EP ‘In a Man’s World’
item.description: Lindi Ngonelo is a pianist, musical director, composer and educator with a strong foundation in jazz and popular music.

item.description: Economic growth seems on track for above 1% by year-end

item.title: The absence of ethical leadership in Ekurhuleni: A call for accountability
item.description: Former Ekurhuleni city manager, Dr Imogen Mashazi, has denied interfering in the disciplinary action against suspended Ekurhuleni Metro Police Department acting chief Brigadier Julius Mkhwanazi.

item.title: South African Poultry Association calls for zero-rating of chicken to combat food insecurity
item.description: A proposal by the South African Poultry Association to zero-rate chicken for VAT purposes would benefit the bottom seven income groups.
